$comment: Source material for building/refining the knowledge graph. scripts/ingest_ncert.py downloads what it can into data/raw/ (gitignored). NCERT textbook PDFs follow a stable URL scheme: https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/<code>1dd.pdf where dd is the zero-padded chapter, or <code>ps.pdf for the full-book zip prefix. Codes below are the official NCERT book codes for Mathematics.

standards_documents.name: Common Core State Standards - Mathematics
standards_documents.note: HTML; grade-by-grade standards K-12. CCSS codes in the KG align to these.

note: ncert.nic.in and cbseacademic.nic.in were unreachable from the authoring environment (network policy). v1 of the graph was authored from NCERT chapter structure + CCSS knowledge; run the ingest script from an unrestricted machine to download sources and refine the graph against the actual texts (see scripts/ingest_ncert.py).
